load_annotations: load bounding box annotations from an Open Images CSV file and filter by minimum object area
load_image_ids: load a list of image IDs from an Open Images file list CSV
load_categories: load category descriptions from an Open Images class descriptions CSV into a dictionary
AnnotatedObjectsOpenImages_init: create an AnnotatedObjectsOpenImages dataset instance for a given split like train or validation
get_image_path: get the file system path for an Open Images image given its image ID
